_description: Per-page-family meta description contract. Same discipline as the title contract: document what's real, flag what's a genuine content gap (NEEDS-COPY), don't invent copy to fill it.

globalRules.targetLength: 140-155 chars (established convention from the calculator content batches this session); tolerated 120-165
globalRules.noKeywordStuffing: every family below sources its description from a real sentence/field describing the actual page, never a keyword list
globalRules.noFabricatedStats: descriptions must only state numbers/claims the page itself substantiates (e.g. '211 scenarios' is fine because the library really has 211; a claim like 'proven to increase conversion' would not be, and none currently exist - production/validate-seo-metadata.mjs's checks 14-15 actively assert this for the AB/journey corpus)
globalRules.noSameSentenceRepeatedAcrossFamily: checked programmatically for the two large corpora (AB: 0 exact duplicate descriptions among 211; journey: 0 exact duplicate descriptions among 255, both via production/validate-seo-metadata.mjs check 7)

home.currentValue: "Data-driven growth for mobile products. Mobile App Growth Lead at Aksigorta; previously Vodafone, Getir and Wingie Enuygun Group." (127 chars, slightly under target - acceptable, it's an identity statement not a search-optimization target)

lab-product.templateStrategy: editorial, one sentence stating what the plugin/tool does

ab-test-library-index.templateStrategy: editorial, states the count (211) and what a row shows

ab-test-library-detail.descriptionSource: src/data/ab-tests.json record's own `seoDescription` field (211/211 populated, English, editorially authored - e.g. AB-001: "An experiment idea that varies only the cart CTA button color against the surrounding palette. See the setup, the tested element and the click-rate metric.")
ab-test-library-detail.templateStrategy: already fully authored per-record, not template-generated - each description names the specific element under test and the metric used, sourced from the record's own hypothesis/whatToTest/primaryKpi fields (per production/ab-test-seo-metadata.json's `sourceBasis` field, which is populated on every record)
ab-test-library-detail.fallback: r.hypothesis.slice(0,155) if seoDescription is ever null - never happens today (0/211)
ab-test-library-detail.uniquenessRule: 0 exact duplicates (check 7), near-duplicate threshold 0.75 Jaccard on stemmed tokens (check 18) - passed, 0 unflagged near pairs

journey-library-detail.descriptionSource: LIVE: journey.purpose (raw field). AUDITED-BUT-NOT-WIRED: production/journey-seo-metadata.json's own `seoDescription` field, independently authored per journey.
journey-library-detail.genuineGap: journey.purpose is internal documentation prose written for people maintaining the 255-journey state-machine library (e.g. 'Carry a meaningful but anonymous intent signal through identity resolution without inventing an identity, and decide lifecycle entry as a question separate from having resolved one.') - grammatically fine, but written in an internal/technical register, not as a public search snippet. production/journey-seo-contract.json's own pre-existing audit already reached this exact conclusion and marked descriptionSource.status = 'NEEDS-COPY' for all 255 records, independent of this round's work.
journey-library-detail.templateStrategy: NOT a template gap - a per-record authoring gap. production/journey-seo-metadata.json already HAS a properly-authored alternative for every one of the 255 records (e.g. ACC-71: 'See how a journey decides whether a right actually exists, keeping granted, denied and pending apart from being eligible or having paid toward it.' - verified 146 chars, well-formed, plain-language, matches the target range) - this is not missing content that needs writing from scratch, it's ALREADY-WRITTEN content that is not yet imported into JourneyRoutes.tsx's journeyMetadata() function.
journey-library-detail.targetLength: 140-155 for the authored alternative (already validated, production/validate-seo-metadata.mjs check 9)
journey-library-detail.uniquenessRule: the authored alternative has 0 exact duplicates and passed near-duplicate checks; journey.purpose (current live field) is separately confirmed unique across all 255 by production/journey-seo-contract.json's own descriptionSource.note
journey-library-detail.verdict: NEEDS-COPY status is CORRECT and unchanged by this round for the CONTRACT layer (the authored alternative already exists and is validated) - but WIRING it into the live journeyMetadata() function is explicitly out of scope this round (that function lives in JourneyRoutes.tsx, a component file). This is the single highest-value, lowest-risk follow-up: swap `description: detail.purpose` for a lookup into production/journey-seo-metadata.json (or its data folded into src/canonical the way ab-tests.json already carries its own seoDescription inline). Flagged as a real blocker to closing this specific gap, NOT a blocker to this round's SEO-ARCHITECTURE-READY verdict, since the contract itself is complete and correct.

calculator-detail.uniquenessRule: cross-page similarity checked by production/calculators/validate-calculator-content.mjs on every batch
calculator-detail.verdict: KEEP AS-IS - out of scope for rewrite per this round's instruction
